import json
demos=json.load(open('programs/task-1b4d92a9.json'))

def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    def build(lines, nsec, size, keep_idx, out_lines):
        pat=lines[keep_idx*(size+1)+1: keep_idx*(size+1)+size+1]
        for t in range(nsec):
            if t==keep_idx: continue
            st=t*(size+1)+1
            for u in range(size): out_lines[st+u]=pat[u][:]
        return out_lines
    for axis in (0,1):
        lines = [row[:] for row in g] if axis==0 else [list(c) for c in zip(*g)]
        h_,w_ = len(lines), len(lines[0])
        seps=[j for j in range(h_) if len(set(lines[j]))==1]
        if len(seps)<2: continue
        size=seps[1]-seps[0]-1
        if size<=0: continue
        if [seps[0]+t*(size+1) for t in range(len(seps))]!=seps: continue
        if (h_+1)!=(size+1)*len(seps): continue
        nsec=len(seps); keep=0
        res=build(lines,nsec,size,keep,[r[:] for r in lines])
        if axis==0: return [r[:] for r in res]
        return [list(r) for r in zip(*res)]
    return g

import json
demos=json.load(open('programs/task-1b4d92a9.json'))

def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    for axis in (0,1):
        lines = [row[:] for row in g] if axis==0 else [list(c) for c in zip(*g)]
        H=len(lines); W=len(lines[0])
        seps=[j for j in range(H) if len(set(lines[j]))==1]
        if not seps: continue
        # assume consecutive equally spaced; size of each section
        size=seps[0] if len(seps)==1 else seps[1]-seps[0]-1
        if size<=0: continue
        nsec=(H+1)//(size+1)
        if nsec*(size+1)-1!=H: continue
        if [t*(size+1)+size for t in range(len(seps))]!=seps: continue
        # keep section with most colors
        def ncol(t): 
            sec=lines[t*(size+1):t*(size+1)+size]
            return len({x for r in sec for x in r})
        keep=max(range(nsec),key=ncol)
        pat=lines[keep*(size+1):keep*(size+1)+size]
        res=[r[:] for r in lines]
        for t in range(nsec):
            if t==keep: continue
            st=t*(size+1)
            for u in range(size): res[st+u]=pat[u][:]
        return [r[:] for r in res] if axis==0 else [list(r) for r in zip(*res)]
    return g

for i,d in enumerate(demos):
    print(i, transform(d['input'])==d['output'])
